"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. cannot afford to risk the cyberequivalent of Pearl Harbor.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
